ruleDefinitions.name: Legitimate Application Dropped Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects programs on a Windows system that should not write scripts to disk

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\eqnedt32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordpad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordview\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CertReq\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Desktopimgdownldr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AcroRd32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RdrCEF\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\finger\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scf$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wsf$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wsh$")))
